judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), a partial spec file (`specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md`), and five failing acceptance tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`. It never actually implemented the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or added `ajv` to `package.json`, meaning the newly added tests fail immediately and the codebase is left in a broken state. None of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`) or unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` were written.
